intro: Nerves Power Oil combines traditional ayurvedic botanicals in a targeted massage formula to soothe overworked areas and support nerve‑muscle wellness. Routine use helps improve circulation, reduce the feel of stiffness, and enhance mobility and flexibility for active living. The non‑sticky oil absorbs quickly and can be used pre‑ or post‑activity; results vary by routine and severity. This is a cosmetic/ayurvedic topical, not a medicine.

li: Ayurvedic massage oil designed to support healthy nerve and muscle function with regular application.
Helps enhance local blood circulation, easing stiffness and numbness for better comfort.
Promotes mobility and flexibility when combined with gentle stretches and warm compress.
Lightweight, fast‑absorbing texture suitable for daily body massage.
30 ml dropper bottle for precise, hygienic application.
Warm a few drops between palms and massage into affected areas for 5–10 minutes until absorbed.
Use 1–2 times daily; for added comfort, apply a warm compress after massage.
Patch test before first use. Do not apply on broken skin.
1 x Nerves Power Oil, 30 ml dropper bottle
Adults seeking ayurvedic support for nerve‑muscle comfort, stiffness relief, and mobility.
External use only; avoid contact with eyes; discontinue if irritation occurs.
Not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent disease. Store cool and dry.
